Hi Olga,

Thanks for the sync earlier — CloudVend is excited about the Redwood listing but we hit one blocker on our side for the standard marketplace certification. Our security team says we need (1) an endpoint to surface per-request telemetry (minimal PII) for auditability, and (2) an exemption to the standard onboarding SLA because our onboarding window includes a third-party SI (Systems Integrators Inc.) that requires additional validation steps.

Quick asks: could Redwood provide a named technical contact and a proposed exception cadence (how we'll handle iterative evidence review)? We are targeting a soft-launch in Q3, so an initial plan by the end of next week would be ideal.

I attached a short matrix of the telemetry fields we need (cloudvend_mvp_requirements.xlsx) and the SOC-related evidence list the SI will request (security_evidence_list.pdf).

Can you loop in the right eng/product owners?

Thanks,

Thanks, Olga. I reviewed the CloudVend matrix and have initial engineering notes below.

Summary of constraints and proposed implementation:

1) Telemetry endpoint
- We can expose a read-only telemetry endpoint that returns per-request metadata (timestamp, model, route_id, latency_ms, request_size, response_tokens). No PII or prompt text.
- Implementation: a lightweight query layer over our internal request-logs store with RBAC scoped to a partner token. Estimated effort: 3-4 engineer days plus 1 day for infra access policy and audit logging.

2) SDK/connector changes
- The connector will need an update to send a partner_id header and support the new telemetry query token exchange. SDK changes: < 2 days for server-side connector, 1 day to update Node and Python samples.

3) Staging & test data
- Request CloudVend to provision a staging account and sample event stream (anonymized). We can provide a small harness to replay ~10k events for validation.

4) Security posture
- We can provide the requested artifacts from our standard SOC2 pack, but the SI will request additional mapping docs. Marcus to produce a mapping doc (connector_fields -> SOC2 controls) by 05/21.

Risks and exceptions:
- If SI requires prompt-level logs, we cannot meet that without a formal data-sharing agreement; we will push for metadata-only.
- The exception cadence should include an explicit sign-off from our security team to avoid rework.

I will draft a short technical appendix (connector_sequence_v1.drawio) and share in the Drive link Olga provided.

Marcus Lin
Engineering Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
